description.part1: Created in 2015 by a group of friends passionate about video games, our esports club has grown to become the THG association, with the ambition of being a benchmark club in Rennes and Brittany!
description.part2: Our goal is to progressively develop across as many competitive games as possible, while organizing our own esports events in Brittany to energize the local scene and bring enthusiasts together.

timeline.subtitle: A two-act journey: first a group of friends recording their games, then a club making its mark on national LANs and European leagues.
timeline.cap: To be continued — the next chapter is being written

history.title: Club history
history.subtitle: From a high-schoolers' living room to a recognized association — ten years building THG.

b1.title: The early days
b1.description: THG was born from a group of high-schoolers sharing a common passion for League of Legends, who started creating content on YouTube. A first phase focused on fun, community and experimentation.

b2.title: First competitions
b2.description: The club takes its first competitive steps at LAN events in Brittany, notably Insalan. THG transitions from a content-creation project to an amateur esports-oriented structure.

b3.title: The Canapé Show
b3.description: Alongside competition, THG grows its Twitch presence with the Canapé Show, a community talk show that reinforces its identity and ties with its small community.

b4.title: Founding the association
b4.description: THG hits a key milestone by formally creating its association. The project takes on a long-term vision with an ambition to professionalize in esports.

b5.title: Competitive turn
b5.description: Launch of a semi-professional League of Legends roster. THG asserts its competitive stance and lays the foundations for its esports development.

competitive.title: Competitive journey
competitive.subtitle: From the first national LAN to an international roster — THG's esports trajectory.

b6.title: Gamers Assembly
b6.description: THG takes part in its first major national LAN, marking an important step in its entry on the competitive scene.

b7.title: LPLOL — Portuguese ERL
b7.description: THG joins the structured competitive scene with its first league participation. The team comes close to the playoffs in its very first season.

b8.title: Nexus Tour
b8.description: THG enters the official French amateur circuit, with the goal of establishing itself sustainably in the competitive ecosystem.

b9.title: Return to Gamers Assembly
b9.description: THG comes back with more experience and significantly improves its on-stage performance. Substitution: Artanis → D1verse in the jungle.

b10.title: A new era
b10.description: THG begins a new phase of development with an international roster, aiming for even higher performance on the competitive circuit.

b11.title: Entering Super Smash Bros Ultimate
b11.description: THG launches on Super Smash Bros Ultimate with the signing of NaetorU, a key figure of the Breton SSBU esports scene. A new playground to proudly carry the colors of Brittany.

b12.title: Nexus League
b12.description: THG steps up and joins the Nexus League with a semi-professional roster, ready to defend Brittany's colors at the highest national level.

lol.title: League Of Legends

league.description: League Of Legends is THG's historic and core game. After several years evolving in the Breton and French amateur scene, we are taking a step up this summer with a semi-professional roster competing in the Nexus League of League Of Legends. Our objective is clear: to progress together, structure our project, and assert our place on the french stage.

tour.description: THG Skol is our academy team, competing in the Nexus Tour. A true springboard for the project, it brings together promising players coming to grow and prove themselves.

tft.text: We are a Breton organization also present on TFT. If you also want to improve at the game and wish to represent our colors in tournaments, do not hesitate to contact us.

ssbu.title: Super Smash Bros Ultimate
ssbu.description: THG is making its mark on the Super Smash Bros Ultimate scene with the arrival of NaetorU, a key figure of the Breton SSBU esports scene! A new playground, the same ambition: representing Brittany at the highest level and bringing the Smash community to life in our colors.

ambassadors.title: Our Ambassadors
ambassadors.description: Discover our talented ambassadors who collaborate with us

0.name: Ezza
0.description: Originally from Brest, EZZA has been playing League Of Legends since Season 2, a well-stacked Emerald, passionate forever! Since 2020, he has blossomed behind the mic as a caster, even launching his own tournaments to live his dream. He promised us to bring maximum hype!

1.name: Toskaan
1.description: A provincial Southerner who went to Paris to live the artistic life he dreamed of. With acting training and a passion for esports as baggage. Toskaan embarked on the esports commentary adventure in November 2023. He first created his collective, with which he organized tournaments on League Of Legends. In 2025, he met another caster, Ezza, who would later become like a mentor. The adventure is just beginning!

2.name: DJ Turbo Biche
2.description: Arthur Biche, alias DJ TURBOBICHE, is a DJ/producer from Dinan. Passionate about electro since childhood, he officially launched in 2024. His style blends bouncy Trance, Hard Trance and Hardtechno, driven by explosive energy. A member of THG, he electrifies parties and events with intensity!
